subject: parser, planner: Add hint `INDEX_LOOKUP_PUSH_DOWN` and implement the planner part (#62714)
summary: Reviewed diff vs parent focusing on parser/planner/executor. This commit adds a new optimizer-hint token/plumbing for `INDEX_LOOKUP_PUSHDOWN` (kept disabled in normal builds via `EnableIndexLookUpPushDownForTest`), introduces `PhysicalLocalIndexLookUp` plus post-order flattening support for multi-child pushdown DAGs, and threads the pushdown flag from hint -> access path -> CopTask -> `PhysicalIndexLookUpReader`. Default behavior remains unchanged because the hint is ignored with warning unless explicitly enabled for tests; no remaining Blocker/High correctness/semantics/consistency issues found in the always-on code paths touched here.
